decision_basis.physical_readiness: Readiness 73/green; sleep 6.07 h with score 75; wake/current Body Battery 88; overnight HRV 48 ms balanced; resting HR 45 versus the seven-day average of 47.
decision_basis.cns_readiness: CNS 89/ready with no independent technical-consequence cap. No current subjective sharpness report exists, so the opening trail segment remains the required field gate.
decision_basis.recent_load: No Monday run or other Monday training occurred. The last seven days contain two sessions, 151.2 minutes and load 212.6, versus prior-seven-day load 313.0.
decision_basis.garmin_diagnosis: Garmin reports Recovery with ACWR 0.5 LOW, but current Load Focus is balanced: low aerobic 280.2 within target, high aerobic 836.1 within target but near its upper bound, and anaerobic 295.4 within target. Low acute load is not evidence of fatigue; it limits open-ended intensity rather than deleting the protected MTB exposure.
decision_basis.density: Today is meaningful exposure one. If Thursday and Friday are both MTB, Thursday must be a low-cost Enduro primer and Friday is the conditional second meaningful exposure.
decision_basis.route_selection: Use familiar 2K as the mandatory field gate, then earn one Pure Quill stage. Repeated Twin Peaks, TnT, Flintstone, the full DH Line, novelty, and setup testing are excluded.

session.title: Kiara Stumpjumper precision gate plus conditional Pure Quill
session.purpose: Use the first protected MTB exposure to validate repeatable front-wheel authority, brake-release timing, and clean corner exits on familiar terrain while adding bounded bike-specific climbing load without compromising the planned Thursday primer and Friday key Enduro exposure.

dose.opening_gate: Use the access riding and first 10-15 minutes at RPE 2-3 to confirm normal breathing-to-RPE, improving or normal legs, wide vision, early line preview, deliberate braking, centred posture, and no unexpected steering or foot correction.
dose.first_cycle: Ride one familiar 2K descent at approximately 80-85 percent execution speed. This is the mandatory technical field gate, not a time trial.
dose.post_2k_gate: Earn Pure Quill only if breathing settles within about five minutes, legs remain normal, vision and decision speed are unchanged, braking release is deliberate, front tracking is accurate, and braking/upper-body fatigue are no more than 2/10.
dose.second_cycle: If the gate passes, climb to Twin Peaks at RPE 4-5 and ride one Pure Quill stage at approximately 85-90 percent execution speed. Normal standing on selected steep pitches is allowed, but no maximal torque, sprint, or power chase.
dose.egress: Use the required climb-out and partial DH-Line exit at transport pace. It is not a third quality repeat.
dose.hard_cap: One 2K gate, one conditional Pure Quill, required egress, 75-95 minutes expected and 100 minutes absolute cap. No second Twin Peaks repeat or substitute stage.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A short familiar precision gate followed by one earned longer stage should reinforce dynamically centred posture, progressive front loading, brake completion and release before turn-in, and clean exit acceleration under moderate accumulated climbing cost, while keeping neural and high-aerobic density low enough for later-week Enduro transfer.
execution_rules: Primary cue: brake firmly while the bike is upright, finish the release before turn-in, remain dynamically centred with progressive front load, then pick the bike up and drive the exit.
Use only familiar lines. Do not test aggressive root lines, jumps, novelty, race pace, segment times, or another rider's speed.
Keep suspension, tyre pressure, cockpit, and cleat settings unchanged.
Climbs are controlled transport and bike-specific load, not threshold or VO2 work. Standing is allowed only when smooth and deliberate.
Do not add another loop because the first two descents feel excellent.
For the full route in Kuala Lumpur heat, target approximately 45-60 g carbohydrate, 650-900 ml fluid, and 600-900 mg sodium per hour. Record actual intake.

expected_result.technical: 2K and Pure Quill show stable front tracking, completed brake release before turn-in, earlier line choice, and clean corner exits without reactive correction, near miss, or late skill fade.
expected_result.physiology: Access and Twin Peaks climbing remain RPE 3-5, whole-session RPE approximately 5-6, with no deliberate sprint, VO2, or threshold block.
expected_result.garmin_training_load: Approximately 120-165 if the opening gate passes and the full route executes.
expected_result.training_effect: Aerobic TE approximately 3.0-3.7 and anaerobic TE approximately 1.0-2.3, governed by controlled climbing and submaximal descending.
expected_result.next_session: Thursday remains available as a low-cost Enduro primer rather than another meaningful durability day.

stop_rules: Fail the opening gate and use the safest easy exit for abnormal breathing-to-RPE, legs that worsen rather than improve, narrowed vision, delayed line preview, unexpected steering/foot correction, illness symptoms, or climb RPE above 4 before the technical dose.

Do not add Pure Quill after 2K if braking becomes reactive or dragged into the apex, front tracking requires correction, posture freezes rearward, a line miss or near miss occurs, or braking/upper-body fatigue exceeds 2/10.
End technical intent for delayed choice, narrowed vision, unclipping delay, front push or deflection, confidence outrunning precision, or any late-session skill fade.
Downshift to transport pace if climb RPE exceeds 6, HR/breathing becomes disproportionate, heat becomes oppressive, or trail conditions raise consequence beyond familiar controlled execution.
Wet roots or active rain remove speed intent. No same-day upgrade, second Twin Peaks repeat, alternate stage, sprint, jump progression, or setup change.
